text: 【周三（10月7日）重点关注财经事件和经济数据】①待定中国9月外汇储备；②07:00美联储洛根发表讲话；③14:00德国8月季调后工业产出月率；④14:00英国9月Halifax季调后房价指数月率；⑤14:45法国8月贸易帐。
text_en: [Key financial events and economic data to watch on Wednesday (October 7)] ① TBD China September foreign exchange reserves; ② 07:00 Fed's Logan speaks; ③ 14:00 Germany August seasonally adjusted industrial production month-on-month; ④ 14:00 UK September Halifax seasonally adjusted house price index month-on-month; ⑤ 14:45 France August trade balance.
